name: Force Fabric MCP Server
description: Provides live optimization analysis and health checks for Microsoft Fabric items including Lakehouses, Warehouses, Eventhouses, and Semantic Models. It enables users to detect performance bottlenecks, data quality issues, and security vulnerabilities using over 100 automated rules.
